milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted crafting_table ends up in the player's inventory after crafting 4 oak_planks in the 2x2 grid. The player starts with 0 crafting_tables, so any presence confirms task completion.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted ladder ends up in the player's inventory after arranging 7 sticks in the crafting_table's 3x3 grid. The player starts with 0 ladders, so any presence confirms task completion. The recipe yields 3 ladders, so min_count=1 is sufficient.
